title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - MeasurementCollectionJob
description: Used to control the periodic collection of performance indicators, implemented as a sub-entity of the PM Measurement Job. (TM Forum TMF628 Performance 4.0.0, Swagger definition MeasurementCollectionJob; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:MeasurementCollectionJob:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MeasurementCollectionJob'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:MeasurementCollectionJob:<tmfId>. unique identifier

performanceIndicatorSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/MeasurementCollectionJob/properties/performanceIndicatorSpecification'. A product to be created defined by value or existing defined by reference. The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the product entity and not the RelatedProductRefOrValue class itself. In TMF this is an array of PerformanceIndicatorSpecificationRefOrValue objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced PerformanceIndicatorSpecification entities (urn:ngsi-ld:PerformanceIndicatorSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
